arrival_coordinate: candidate arrivals include capture lead and use nominal RX capture seconds
calibration_scope: all timing candidates and both bits are retained; residual variance must be calibrated independently within each fixed group, with a family allocation across groups
source_hash_binding: not included; bind externally to the exact source and binary
signal_energy_semantics: post-erasure actual signal energy; simulation evaluation only
mean_semantics: grouped A^H W actual signal; simulation evaluation only
receiver_metadata_warning: All means/energies are simulation truth and are not receiver metadata
observation_semantics: A^H W y from the one shared actual noisy channel pass, projected separately for every fixed group
received_energy_semantics: common per-block actual noisy sample energy over valid rows

random_seed_roots.fallback: unset oscillator/noise/frontend/path roots inherit the resolved channel seed
random_seed_roots.channel_root_scope: static timing/CFO/clock/drift truth, spread ray, and frequency-selective perturbation
random_seed_roots.oscillator_root_scope: TX/RX oscillator spectra and FHSS phase resets
random_seed_roots.frontend_root_scope: DAC/ADC conversion, impulse process, and tone phase
random_seed_roots.path_root_scope: independent stationary OU or Gaussian-FIR ray gains and initial diurnal path phase

channel_model.selective_modulation_rate_source: effective spread Doppler; slow component runs at one tenth
channel_model.selective_frequency_frame: fixed public channel frame; hidden oscillator truth is never used to recenter
channel_model.selective_law_note: dispersive-dft-v1 with auto scale is a spacing-scaled stress law; it does not represent the separately configured ray delay or Doppler
channel_model.sample_clock_reference: independent TX/RX endpoint errors; truth_clock_ppm reports their exact ratio

spread_inputs.semantics: selected preset supplies nominal dimensions; explicit physical overrides replace their own nominal dimension before one margin multiplication; without preset, legacy channel values supply the base, and remain already effective when no override is supplied; receiver tap basis is independent

path_evolution.gaussian_target_correlation: exp(-0.5*(pi*B*tau)^2); B=2*sigma of each ray Gaussian Doppler PSD; existing ray-center separation is independent
path_evolution.gaussian_teacher: stationary proper-complex white Gaussian innovations convolved with a discrete L2-normalized Gaussian FIR; finite truncation and sampling approximate the target covariance; actual FIR shape is reported separately
path_evolution.ray_model: fixed unit ray gains; existing equal-power two-ray delay and Doppler retained when selected
path_evolution.outage_model: signal-only attenuation on [start,end), with cosine descent/ascent inside the interval; thermal noise and path/filter state continue
path_evolution.scope: declared physical-path stress, not field calibration; OU is point sampled and has an unbounded analog spectrum; the Gaussian FIR target also has unbounded spectral tails and its six-sigma-per-edge capture allowance is not strict support, so finite deterministic capture bounds are not a bandwidth guarantee and sampling-rate refinement is required

source_hash_note: source and binary hashes must be bound externally to this uncommitted study build

resolved_configuration.topology: no RF shift oscillator; baseband reference only
resolved_configuration.frequency_parameter_scope: RF and conversion-IF values multiply oscillator errors; the sampled signal is zero-centered complex baseband
resolved_configuration.sampling_clock_model: constant endpoint ppm; shared mode correlates static RF/audio ppm and counts base phase diffusion once; stochastic phase does not perturb sampling coordinates

selective_channel.modulation_rate_source: effective spread Doppler; slow component runs at one tenth
selective_channel.frequency_frame: fixed public channel frame; never recentered from hidden oscillator truth
selective_channel.interpretation: dispersive-dft-v1 is a spacing-scaled stress law when the scale is auto; selected ray delay and Doppler remain separate physical dimensions

spread_inputs.semantics: selected preset supplies nominal dimensions; explicit physical overrides replace their own nominal dimension before one margin multiplication; without preset, legacy channel values supply the base, and remain already effective when no override is supplied; receiver tap basis is independent

path_evolution.gaussian_target_correlation: exp(-0.5*(pi*B*tau)^2); B=2*sigma of each ray Gaussian Doppler PSD; existing ray-center separation is independent
path_evolution.gaussian_teacher: stationary proper-complex white Gaussian innovations convolved with a discrete L2-normalized Gaussian FIR; finite truncation and sampling approximate the target covariance; actual FIR shape is reported separately
path_evolution.ray_model: fixed unit ray gains; existing equal-power two-ray delay and Doppler retained when selected
path_evolution.outage_model: signal-only attenuation on [start,end), with cosine descent/ascent inside the interval; thermal noise and path/filter state continue
path_evolution.scope: declared physical-path stress, not field calibration; OU is point sampled and has an unbounded analog spectrum; the Gaussian FIR target also has unbounded spectral tails and its six-sigma-per-edge capture allowance is not strict support, so finite deterministic capture bounds are not a bandwidth guarantee and sampling-rate refinement is required

resolved_configuration.explicit_arrival_seed_domain: channel seed XOR 0x94d049bb133111eb; independent mt19937_64 stream
resolved_configuration.timing_convention: raw samples use offset + TX lag - RX lag with both lags causal [0,Audio], giving zero-centered +/-Audio relative lag; the calendar timestamp helper has a separate +Audio/2 coordinate center; region is total width and UTC clock bounds are per station
resolved_configuration.truth_selection: physical endpoint/clock draws independent of public search; inactive UTC policy means fixed zero initial timing; explicit truth frequency/drift and keyed epoch offset remain independent
resolved_configuration.epoch_address_scope: explicit independent keyed-epoch offset; PC timing draws do not silently choose a crypto epoch

search_estimates.timing_model: squared raised-cosine chip autocorrelation times squared equal-power three-carrier Dirichlet factor; first-main-lobe bisection
search_estimates.timing_model_assumptions: independent zero-mean random chips; equal mean carrier powers; one shared complex gain; infinite RRC pulse; worst mismatch half a uniform grid step with both endpoints covered
search_estimates.timing_model_limits: finite keyed patterns, truncated pulse, sampled interpolation, channel uncertainty, outages and clock/timing joint mismatch require independent validation
search_estimates.clock_step_model: endpoint displacement over the complete bit equals timing_maximum_step_seconds; same approximate timing loss budget
search_estimates.scope: finite-grid estimates only; no implicit bank generation, pruning, phase-path count or reception guarantee

capture.scope: whole deterministic RF/audio-error bound, public CFO grid, maximum diurnal instantaneous frequency and Gaussian-ray allowance of six sigma per edge; stochastic oscillator and ray spectral tails are not a bounded capture guarantee
capture.sampling_model_limits: below 64 samples/s: FHSS, dropout, active sampled frontend, slow AGC, white/flicker/random-walk FM and white PM are rejected; constant offsets, Wiener phase, fractional two-ray propagation and selected selective perturbations remain modeled in physical seconds; no high-rate integration/decimation equivalence is claimed

duration.scope: ten-Julian-year requested-active limit; complete private tiles, internal burst waits, pulse padding and channel/capture tails may extend actual elapsed duration

whole_bit_symbol_burst.scope: one-bit source renders this slot only; successor is public calendar metadata, not three internal wait tiles or multi-bit runtime support

receiver_observation.missed_dwell_calendar: floor((n/(Fs*RX_clock_scale) - capture_lead_seconds + retune_offset_seconds - calendar_origin_sample/Fs)/dwell_seconds); only nonnegative public receiver dwell indices are maskable
receiver_observation.erasure_stage: after physical channel, noise and frontend; output I/Q and validity become zero while all physical state advances
receiver_observation.coverage_policy_scope: C++ run receiver only; complete-calendar requirement and likelihood thresholds remain unchanged; external scorers declare their own coverage policy

sampled_frontend.impulse_process: one-sample occupancy probability 1-exp(-rate/Fs_RX); at most one event per sample; independent uniform phase
sampled_frontend.ordering: shaped source; DAC gain, ENOB error, TPDF and quantization; TX oscillator and gain; shared propagation; RX oscillator; thermal noise; receiver-coordinate interference; one-pole analog filter; legacy slow AGC; gain step and overload recovery; ADC gain, ENOB error, TPDF and quantization; observed erasure mask
sampled_frontend.converter_error_model: synthetic independent Gaussian input error, variance=(step_ENOB^2-step_nominal^2)/12; not calibrated hardware ENOB or distortion
sampled_frontend.tone_coordinate: receiver tuned baseband; not fixed RF; occupancy uses receiver nominal t=0 400-ms dwells
sampled_frontend.dac_dither_guards: converter noise can occupy shaped guards while finite transmitter source exists; absent transmitter disables DAC
sampled_frontend.noise_normalization: reported variance is pre-frontend thermal input variance; transformed samples may be colored and non-Gaussian
sampled_frontend.signal_energy_report_stage: after shared propagation and RX oscillator; before thermal noise and sampled frontend

endpoint_truth.scope: simulation evaluation only; endpoint realizations are never receiver search inputs

gaussian_ray_teacher.covariance_formula: R[m]=sum(k=0..L-1-m,h[k]*h[k+m]) for 0<=m<L, otherwise 0; lag_seconds=m*sample_interval_seconds; proper-complex variance R[0]=1 when active
gaussian_ray_teacher.scope: actual finite sampled teacher covariance; empty coefficients and zero sample interval when disabled; evaluation/oracle diagnostics only, distinct from ideal Gaussian target

selective_perturbation.response_period_scope: ideal continuous-delay law; sampled cubic FIR perturbs this periodicity and has exact digital period Fs
selective_perturbation.branch_interpolation: causal cubic Lagrange fractional delay; four taps at floor(delay_samples)+{-1,0,1,2}; exact integer-delay shortcut
selective_perturbation.phase_origin: first physical RX capture row (index 0), before the first phase step; not calendar time zero
selective_perturbation.energy_scope: sum of squared complex signal magnitudes over all processed capture rows, including captured tails; immediately before/after selective processing, before RX oscillator, thermal noise, frontend and observed erasures; divide by sample_rate_hz for physical-time energy
selective_perturbation.tail_scope: finite causal delay-filter memory plus the configured total-tail floor; no selected stage is truncated

path_truth_simulation_only.scope: seeded physical truth; never a practical receiver search input

observation_endpoint_report.scope: natural endpoint includes all source/interpolation/ray/selective/frontend tails; public fixed calendar may append zero-input observation rows
